answer: Random peer-review audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of agents, and three auditors wander through each one's river of recent work, checking jobs against claims. A majority fake verdict burns its 40 POA deposit. Forging 100 identities parks 4,000 POA at risk of slashing, so expected loss beats any reward. An honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit, refunded after clean audits, and earns 2 POA per audit, reaching the summit.
